title: [WIP] Fix test failure in CI pipeline
body:
## Fix CI Build Failures

### Issues Found
1. **TypeScript error in ObjectGrid.tsx** - Line 344 uses invalid `variant="destructive"` prop on DropdownMenuItem
2. **Runtime error in docs build** - Header-bar component uses SidebarTrigger without SidebarProvider context

### Plan
- [x] Investigate CI failures using GitHub Actions logs
- [x] Identify root causes of build failures
- [x] Fix ObjectGrid.tsx - Remove invalid variant prop and use className instead for destructive styling
- [x] Fix header-bar.tsx - Wrap SchemaRenderer in InteractiveDemo with SidebarProvider
- [x] Test the build locally
- [x] Address code review feedback
  - [x] Reset SidebarProvider layout classes in demos to prevent layout issues
  - [x] Enhance destructive menu item styling with focus background
- [x] Verify all fixes work correctly

### Changes Made
1. **ObjectGrid.tsx**: Replaced invalid `variant="destructive"` with proper className styling including focus states
2. **InteractiveDemo.tsx**: Created DemoWrapper that provides SidebarProvider context while resetting layout classes that would interfere with isolated component demos
